title: Hummus among us!
text: Hummus among us!. I bought this to use as part of a photoshoot for a blog tour of [[ASIN:0425272230 My Fat Dad: A Memoir of Food, Love, and Family, with Recipes]] and wasn't disappointed. This was my first purchase of Mud Pie tableware, and I loved the embossed lettering (the spreader is made from a very lightweight metal and I would have preferred to see something more durable / weightier, but it gets the job done). The bowl is the perfect size for a single batch of hummus in the Vitamix using one can of chickpeas and makes a statement on your table! The only downside is the included spreader DOES leave faint grey marks on the glaze, so now I use a soft silicone spatula to clean out the bowl instead. This would make a super-cute housewarming gift or wedding gift paired with my friend Maureen Abood's hummus starter kit, available from Maureen Abood Market, as well as a copy of her excellent [[ASIN:0762454865 Rose Water and Orange Blossoms: Fresh & Classic Recipes from my Lebanese Kitchen]].
